text_prompt: This is a lifestyle short video clip, shot with a fixed medium close-up lens steadily focused on the person's front. The scene is set in a warmly lit indoor café corner, with blurred red-and-white decorations in the background forming soft color blocks. In the frame, a young male with brown short hair, slightly fluffy and textured, wearing a deep blue V-neck sweater, looks bright-eyed at the camera with a faint smile on his lips. He leans forward slightly and says in a light, cheerful tone: “This project went smoother than expected.” Background sounds include the hiss of a coffee machine steamer and a faint jazz melody in the distance.

This is a slice-of-life comedy short scene, captured with a slow push-in medium close-up shot. The camera angles in slightly from the front-right, delicately capturing the subtle micro-expressions across the man's face. The setting is a nostalgic, lived-in café filled with everyday charm, where warm yellow light softly cascades from above. In the frame, a middle-aged to elderly male with short, salt-and-pepper textured hair and deeply etched forehead wrinkles wears a fine blue-and-white checkered shirt, layered under a dark black corduroy blazer. He frantically pats his chest pocket and pants pockets, his eyes suddenly widening in panic—then his movements freeze. Slowly, he lifts his head, revealing a faint, awkward yet polite wry smile. In a hushed tone, he says: “Oops, I think I forgot my wallet.” Background sounds include the gentle clink of cups and distant classical music faintly playing in the background.

This is a historical legend/educational drama clip, captured with a slowly advancing medium close-up lens from a slightly left-angled view, focusing on the aged sage's deeply textured and story-rich facial expressions. The setting is a classic study room with dramatic lighting, where soft side light illuminates floating dust particles in the air. In the frame, an elderly male with iconic wild silver long hair and thick gray mustache, wearing a heavy tweed coat in gray-brown tones, gazes into the void in deep contemplation. Then, as if grasping a profound truth, his brows relax and he slowly lifts his head to face the camera. His eyes sparkle with all-knowing wisdom as he says calmly and deeply: “Imagination is more important than knowledge.”, a serene, timeless smile gracing his lips. Background sounds include the scratch of a quill pen and the steady tick of an antique pendulum clock.

This is a behind-the-scenes documentary clip from a film, shot with a slowly advancing close-up lens, starting from the fabric folds at the collarbone and gradually moving upward to lock onto the person's facial expression. The scene is set in a quiet interview room or studio, with a softly blurred background of light vertical stripes, and gentle frontal lighting illuminating the subject. In the frame, a woman with long wavy dark brown hair, wearing a simple black top, her hands gently clasped in front of her chest at the neckline, gazes firmly into the camera. She takes a soft breath, as if about to share an important decision, and says in a clear, steady tone: “I choose to believe in this story—and in myself.” Background sound is extremely quiet, with only faint equipment hum, emphasizing the gravity of her words.
